gaps: G1: formatPermissionReceiptText branches on decision.mode and ignores the SCHED-1 provenance it already receives — the run-only copy must key on repeatableForFutureRuns with a legacy mode fallback.
G2: notifyJobSetupRequired's notified boolean is dropped at all three finalization call sites — the completion builder has no signal to fold/suppress on.
G3: closestRule is plumbed to PermissionApprovalRequest and rendered by zero channels; commands echoed into chat must pass sanitizePermissionCommandText and patterns sanitizePermissionText.
G4: permission_promotion_counters createdAt/updatedAt are fetched but not propagated — the day-span needs firstAskedAt beside promotionHintCount, no storage work.
G5: with multiple RunCommand rules the matcher's closestRule is first-parsed, not similarity-ranked — display may show an arbitrary pattern (documented ceiling; similarity ranking is follow-up).
contradictions: C1: the addendum asks for a read-only-defaults-durable scope selector — the deterministic read-only gate already auto-allows those tools before any human prompt exists; no option-layer default is needed and the locked option set (no-timed-grant) stands.

C2: 'asked N times' framed per (job, tool) — the existing counter keys on (app, agentFolder, suggestionKey); per-job would be a schema change the spec doesn't require. Per agent+tool-shape is adopted deliberately.
resolutions: G1: receipt keys on repeatableForFutureRuns === false (mode === 'allow_once' fallback), next-run sentence only on the jobId context branch.

G2: finalizeSchedulerJobRun returns setupNotified; terminal notify folds ('Completed with limits' + degraded line from JobRunDiagnostics) and suppresses the standalone card for recovered runs, extending the existing suppression precedent.
G3: approved/attempted lines render in formatPermissionContextLines through the sanitizer gates, reaching all providers; denial wording splits unmatched vs not-granted in permission-decision-message.
G4: firstAskedAt propagated through the classifier hint path; escalation copy replaces the promotion hint at the existing threshold.
G5: kept as a code-comment ceiling; behavior unchanged when a single rule exists (the incident case).
C1: no option-set change shipped; plan documents why.
C2: per-agent keying adopted and noted in code.
